apps.name: Apps Link Manager
apps.description: Manage, copy and track all your app download links in one dashboard.
apps.fullDescription:
Apps Link Manager gives you a clean dashboard to organize every APK, AAB, ZIP, HTML and desktop build you publish.
See total apps and total storage at a glance, filter by file type, search by name, and copy or delete links in one click.
Built with a dark, modern interface.

apps.name: Trending Apps Radar
apps.description: See the most popular apps right now on GitHub, Google Play and the App Store.
apps.fullDescription:
Track the apps that are trending today across GitHub, Google Play and the App Store in a single table.
Filter by store, compare ratings, installs and update dates, and discover what everyone is downloading.
Arabic and English interface with a dark theme.

apps.name: Trending Videos Radar
apps.description: Discover the most trending YouTube videos right now.
apps.fullDescription:
A live table of the most popular YouTube videos with views, likes, categories and publish dates.
Filter by country and category, sort by any column and spot rising videos before they go viral.
Arabic and English interface with a dark theme.

apps.name: Smart Notes
apps.description: Write notes with reminders, repeat options and custom alarm ringtones.
apps.fullDescription:
Capture your ideas with a title, detailed content and drawing tools (pen, brush, colors and sizes).
Set a date and time reminder, choose how often it repeats and pick your own alarm ringtone.
Simple, fast and works offline.

apps.name: Free PDF Tools
apps.description: Open, edit, merge and convert any PDF for free.
apps.fullDescription:
All the essential PDF tools in one app: edit and write on PDFs, convert PDF to JPG, turn images into PDF and merge multiple files.
Scan documents, rearrange pages, protect files and quickly access your recent files.
Fast, free and easy to use.

apps.name: Voice to Text
apps.description: Turn your speech into text instantly in many languages.
apps.fullDescription:
Tap the microphone and speak: your words appear as text in real time.
Choose the language, adjust font and size, then save, copy or share your transcript.
Clean dark interface designed for fast dictation.

apps.name: Uploria
apps.description: Upload ready photos: passport and ID photos in seconds.
apps.fullDescription:
Uploria resizes and compresses your photos to the exact dimensions and file size required for passports, visas and online forms.
Choose the document type, preview the result and save the file in one tap.
Perfect for official applications.

apps.name: Ad Generator
apps.description: Create professional marketing ads from a product photo, name and price.
apps.fullDescription:
Upload your product photo, enter the name and price, and get a ready-to-post professional ad in seconds.
Designed for social media: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
Free for everyone.

apps.name: Location Service
apps.description: Find places and share your location with a simple, smart service.
apps.fullDescription:
Search for nearby places, register your own location and navigate with a clean futuristic map interface.
Simple Arabic-first design with quick access to your saved locations.
Fast and lightweight.
